False impression: the level was an all-time high — both the count (~21.5k vs ~24.7k in 1991) and especially the rate (~6.5 vs ~10 per 100k) stayed below early-90s peaks. Record increase ≠ record level.
source_of_truth: FBI Uniform Crime Reports / CDC homicide mortality data

True on encounters, unestablished on unique people — materially incomplete per §4.
source_of_truth: U.S. Customs and Border Protection encounter statistics; Pew Research explainer
